explanation: Germany came closest, missing only 1930, when it did not enter, and 1950, when it was not allowed to take part after the Second World War.

claims.text: Brazil played at all 22 men's FIFA World Cups from 1930 to 2022, and no other team did.
Germany, Argentina and Italy each missed at least one men's World Cup between 1930 and 2022.
Germany did not enter the 1930 World Cup and was not permitted to take part in 1950.
After Brazil, Germany played at the most men's World Cups from 1930 to 2022: 20 of the 22.
